name: aether-plugin
description: Aether Plugin: an opt-in Aether mode for Claude Code, built for RADAR: a Lead, a Writer, a Judge and a supervised swarm.

plugins.name: aether
plugins.description: Aether mode: the Lead as the owner's right hand, starting on Sonnet and working along three paths (itself, delegate tasks on models it chooses, or the swarm), a Judge on Opus, and a parallel swarm that implements approved plans. Start it with claude --agent aether:lead --effort xhigh.
